decks.notes: The main idea of this deck is to use a combination of Goblins and sacrifice effects to generate value and card advantage. By sacrificing creatures like Putrid Goblin and Goblin Matron, as well as artifacts like Chromatic Star and Ichor Wellspring, the deck can create a loop of card draw and mana generation. Additionally, cards like Deadly Dispute and Fanatical Offering can be used to further fuel this engine. The deck also includes some disruption with cards like Duress and Mesmeric Fiend to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on quickly establishing a board presence with cheap, aggressive white creatures and utilizing cards like Guardians' Pledge and Battle Screech to overwhelm the opponent. It also includes cards like Journey to Nowhere for removal and Palace Sentinels for card advantage. The goal is to apply early pressure and maintain board control to secure a quick victory in a Pauper 1 vs 1 match.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm opponents with a quick and aggressive strategy, using efficient creatures and burn spells to deal damage quickly. The deck utilizes cards like Glint Hawk and Kor Skyfisher to provide continual pressure, while also including cards like Galvanic Blast and Lightning Bolt to deal direct damage to the opponent or remove threats. By combining cheap creatures with powerful auras like All That Glitters, the deck aims to quickly build a strong board presence and push for a fast victory.

The main strategy of this Dimir Control deck is to utilize a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw to control the game and outvalue the opponent. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with efficient removal such as Snuff Out and Chainer's Edict, while also having answers to threats with cards like Spellstutter Sprite and Gurmag Angler. By managing the opponent's threats and resources, the deck can overwhelm the opponent with card advantage and eventually take control of the game.

The key strategy of this Dimir Control deck is to control the game by using efficient removal spells like Agony Warp and Chainer's Edict, backed up by counterspells such as Counterspell. The deck also employs evasive creatures like Ninja of the Deep Hours and Spellstutter Sprite to apply pressure on the opponent while digging for answers with cards like Brainstorm and Preordain. The deck aims to grind out the opponent's resources and eventually establish control over the game, ultimately winning through either card advantage or by overwhelming the opponent with powerful threats like Gurmag Angler.

The main focus of this Golgari/Jund Garden Control deck is to maintain control of the board through removal spells like Cast Down, Defile, and Crypt Rats while generating value with cards like Deadly Dispute and Fanatical Offering. The deck also utilizes tokens from cards like Khalni Garden and Troll of Khazad-dûm to pressure the opponent and provide sacrifice outlets for effects like Avenging Hunter and Tithing Blade. The inclusion of Thorn of the Black Rose and Reckoner's Bargain helps to generate card advantage, while Witch's Cottage and Golgari Rot Farm provide recursion for key threats.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize sacrifice effects and token production to control the board and outvalue the opponent. By sacrificing creatures like Troll of Khazad-dûm with Deadly Dispute or using Crypt Rats to wipe the board, the deck aims to maintain board advantage while generating tokens from cards like Khalni Garden and Ichor Wellspring. Thorn of the Black Rose helps to maintain card advantage, while removal spells like Cast Down and Defile control the opponent's threats. Overall, the deck focuses on attrition and efficient resource management to outlast opponents.

The main concept of this deck is to create a combo using Goblins to generate mana and sacrifice creatures to deal damage or draw cards. By utilizing cards like Putrid Goblin, Skirk Prospector, and Drossforge Bridge, the player can build a strong board presence and overwhelm their opponent with a combination of sacrifice effects and card advantage. The inclusion of cards like Candy Trail and Deadly Dispute allows for additional value from sacrificing creatures, while cards like Mesmeric Fiend and Dark-Dweller Oracle provide disruption and card selection. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of token generation, sacrifice effects, and card advantage.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly deploy low-cost creatures and spells to deal damage quickly, with a mix of direct damage spells and efficient creatures to apply pressure on the opponent. Utilizing artifact synergy and card advantage engines, the deck aims to maintain a steady stream of threats while disrupting the opponent's strategy with removal spells. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive game plan, with a mix of lands that provide colored mana and additional benefits to support the aggressive strategy.

This deck focuses on aggressively playing cheap artifact creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a high number of threats. By combining artifact synergies with cards like All That Glitters and Metallic Rebuke, the deck aims to establish a strong board presence and tempo advantage early in the game. With a mix of efficient creatures and card draw, it looks to maintain pressure and control the board while quickly closing out the game.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing a combination of removal spells, counter spells, and creatures with disruptive abilities. By constantly interacting with the opponent's plays, the deck aims to maintain control of the game until it can establish a dominant position and win through incremental advantage. The deck also features card draw and selection spells to ensure consistency in drawing key cards. In addition, the deck includes a mix of threats and powerful spells to provide different lines of attack and keep the opponent off balance.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game using powerful gate cards and counter spells while maintaining board presence with creatures like Guardian of the Guildpact and Squadron Hawk. The deck utilizes a mix of removal spells like Journey to Nowhere and defensive spells like Prismatic Strands to control the game until it can overwhelm the opponent with threats. By using the synergy between gates and creatures, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and secure victory through superior card advantage and strategic play.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive red creatures and burn spells. The deck utilizes low-cost creatures like Goblin Bushwhacker and Goblin Tomb Raider combined with efficient burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast to try and take down the opponent's life total as fast as possible. Cards like Kuldotha Rebirth and Implement of Combustion help to generate additional value from sacrificing artifacts. The goal is to apply constant pressure and finish off the opponent before they can stabilize and turn the game around.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through a combination of countering spells, creature removal, and card draw. By using cards like Contaminated Aquifer and Lórien Revealed to fix mana, the deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategies while gaining card advantage through spells like Brainstorm and Augur of Bolas. The deck also utilizes evasive threats like Ninja of the Deep Hours and Spellstutter Sprite to apply pressure and maintain control of the game. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and secure victory through superior resource management.

The deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with cheap artifacts and utilizing them to power up key cards like All That Glitters. It aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of aggressive creatures like Gingerbrute and Myr Enforcer, while also disrupting opponents with counterspells like Metallic Rebuke. By utilizing a mix of card draw, artifact synergy, and efficient creatures, the deck aims to maintain pressure and outpace opponents in the early to mid-game.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through the use of gates and various creature and spell interactions. The deck utilizes a mix of creatures like Squadron Hawk and Guardian of the Guildpact alongside removal spells like Journey to Nowhere to maintain board control. Prismatic Strands provides protection against enemy attacks, while Open the Gates allows for ramp and fixing. Brainstorm helps with card selection and manipulation, while cards like Goliath Paladin and Palace Sentinels offer strong late-game options. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent through a combination of control and gate synergies.
